data.title: Aged / Disabled Carer
data.summary: Experienced Aged & Disabled Carer for 43-bed Lockleys facility. Cert III & 2yrs exp req. Provide personal care, mobility & emotional support. Rostered weekend shifts + penalties.
data.application:
To ensure your application is processed efficiently, please provide the following:

  • Updated Resume: Clearly detailing at least 2 years of experience in aged or disability care. Please highlight your experience performing tasks such as personal hygiene, mobility support, and household assistance.
  • Cover Letter: Briefly outlining your suitability for a 43-bed residential environment and confirming your availability for rostered weekend shifts.
  • Mandatory Documents: Please attach or be prepared to provide:
    • AQF Certificate III (Individual Support/Aged Care or equivalent).
    • Current First Aid and CPR Certificate.
    • Current National Police Check (cleared for aged care).

Incomplete applications may not be considered for an interview.
